description: High school space enthusiast and self-taught programmer competing solo in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge (Batticaloa Local Event). Using orbital mechanics, Celestia 1.6.4 Lua scripting, and NASA JPL/PDS datasets, I built "Project GOP: Ghost Fleet" to honor humanity’s inactive off-world hardware through accurate 3D visualization and engineering storytelling.
summary: Project GOP: Ghost Fleet is an interactive 3D web explorer built with React, Node.js, and Three.js that brings abandoned lunar and Martian spacecraft back to life. Using real NASA planetary data and 3D hardware models, it lets students and enthusiasts inspect historic landing sites, real-time solar lighting, and mission telemetry directly in the browser.
details:
The Challenge & Vision Decades of space exploration have left behind a "ghost fleet" of historic landers, rovers, and ascent stages across the Moon and Mars. Yet to most students and the general public, these monumental artifacts remain distant points on static 2D maps. Project GOP: Ghost Fleet bridges this gap by transforming open NASA planetary data and 3D engineering models into an accessible, interactive 3D heritage explorer right in the browser.

How It Works Built with a modular React frontend, a Node.js runtime environment, and a Three.js WebGL rendering engine, Project GOP allows users to:

  • Explore High-Resolution Celestial Globes: Switch seamlessly between lunar and Martian terrain mapped with accurate coordinate beacons for iconic sites like Tranquility Base (Apollo 11), Hadley Rille (Apollo 15), Gusev Crater (Spirit), Meridiani Planum (Opportunity), Elysium Planitia (InSight), and Jezero Crater (Ingenuity).
  • Simulate Real-Time Solar Terminator Lighting: Adjust the solar angle dynamically to watch shadows stretch across craters and landing zones just as they do on the lunar and Martian surfaces.
  • Inspect 3D Hardware & Archival Dossiers: Dive into mission telemetry, historical milestones, and a 3D Hardware Studio supporting .glb NASA spacecraft meshes and high-resolution surface maps.

Impact Designed with accessibility and smooth browser performance in mind, the application empowers young learners and space enthusiasts everywhere to explore humanity's off-world history firsthand.
